opening.argument: The visible exchange centers on giving Gary Johnson his first Bitcoin, not on asking viewers to participate. The speaker says the exchange depends on his phone remaining usable, while the phone’s screen and any transaction state are not visible. Bitcoin is presented as a payment technology with claimed transaction benefits and as a way to challenge the Federal Reserve. Although Bitclub Network is identified and Bitcoin is described favorably, the available content shows no deceptive earnings promise, request for viewers to send money or data, or consequential solicitation. The record supports a discussion and demonstration of Bitcoin, without establishing that the exchange was completed.

citations.quote: So we are getting Gary Johnson his first Bitcoin here in Salt Lake. Hopefully. As long as his phone doesn't die beforehand!
No fees, instantaneous, no frozen accounts are charged backs.
Bitcoin is the best way I can think of to destroy the Federal Reserve.
